Samira Khan: Heads-up — Acme POC kickoff. Need a quick decision on deployment mode + region. Customer insists on EU data residency and wants 3-week POC. Main asks: low latency for chat, <2% hallucination on our NLU prompts, and predictable cost. Can we scope Hosted vs Dedicated tradeoffs and a suggested timeline?
Ethan Li: For an EU-residency constraint we can do Hosted in eu-west if they accept shared infra. Dedicated (EU-only pool) if they need isolation/SLA. What's their expected concurrent users / QPS?
Samira Khan: Early ask is ~50 concurrent chat users peak, 200k tokens/day. Will confirm, but budget-conscious. Also they flagged a security questionnaire — will paste later.
Priya Nair: Quick notes: Hosted = fastest to start (hours), pay-as-you-go. Dedicated = reservation, predictable throughput, private pools, takes ~5 business days to provision if EU GPUs available. If they want VPC/private control plane => Private deployment (longer, legal + infra).
Marco Diaz: From infra side: performance target we can hit if we pick a 70B quantized model + batching/caching. 95th perc latency goal of <250ms for 1-turn chat is achievable with Dedicated; Hosted should hit ~300-400ms depending on load. We can add prefix KV caching to cut token cost.
Ethan Li: For success criteria propose: 1) Functional: intent F1 >= 0.92 on their eval set; 2) Quality: hallucination <= 2% on sample prompts; 3) Perf: 95p latency < 300ms (Hosted) or <250ms (Dedicated); 4) Stability: no errors under 50 concurrent users.
Samira Khan: Good list. Pricing question from procurement: rough monthly estimate for expected usage (200k tokens/day). Can you ballpark Hosted vs Dedicated?
Priya Nair: Ballpark: Hosted PAYG example — ~1M tokens ~ $X (depends on model). For their volume (~6M tokens/month) hosted might be ~$1.5k–$2k/mo. Dedicated reserve (small pool) pricing: ~$8k–$12k/mo depending on commit and region. Private deployment pricing is significantly higher (setup + license). I'll get exact numbers in the SOW.
Samira Khan: Noted. Security questionnaire items they care about: SOC2, KMS, IP allowlist, audit logs, MDR. @SecurityBot can you attach the SOC2 + KMS support checklist?
SecurityBot: Uploaded: SOC2 report (redacted) + KMS integration notes. For Private/Dedicated: we support customer KMS and VPC peering for audit requirements.
Ethan Li: Suggested POC timeline (3 weeks):
- Week 0 (setup): sign SOW + decide mode -> provision Hosted/EU or spin up Dedicated EU pool.
- Week 1: integration & sample prompts, auth, routing. Run smoke tests.
- Week 2: run full eval harness (1k–2k queries), collect metrics (latency, tokens, hallucination), iterate.
- Week 3: tuning, handover, knowledge transfer, export eval results.
Samira Khan: POC acceptance checklist needed so customer can sign off. Ethan, Priya can you draft a 6-point checklist we can include in SOW?
Priya Nair: I'll draft. Quick sample prompts for their NLU checks:
```
User: "Book me a meeting with finance next week"
Expected: intent: schedule_meeting, entities: {department: finance, time_window: next_week}
User: "Why was my invoice higher this month?"
Expected: intent: billing_inquiry
```
Ethan Li: Action items: 1) Decide POC mode now — my recommendation: start Hosted in eu-west to shorten lead time and collect real metrics; if they insist on isolation we switch to Dedicated in week1. 2) Priya to provide pricing SOW numbers. 3) Marco to confirm provisioning ETA for Dedicated EU GPUs. 4) Priya/Ethan to prepare eval harness and send sample prompts to customer.
Marco Diaz: Confirmed — Dedicated EU GPU pool lead time 3–5 business days if quotas available. If not, fallback is Hosted EU. We'll also prepare a routing policy to fallback to smaller model if Dedicated capacity spikes.
Samira Khan: Sounds good. I'll propose the hybrid plan in the SOW: start Hosted EU for immediate testing, with option to transition to Dedicated EU for SLA/data isolation. Timeline = 3 weeks, acceptance criteria = Ethan's list. Priya please add pricing numbers + SOW language.
Priya Nair: Will do today. Also adding: estimate of token-level cost delta if we enable caching + quantization (usually ~30–50% savings).
Samira Khan: Thanks team. I'll post the SOW draft in this thread for quick review. :thumbsup:
